name: MEVBot_0x8c2d
fix_description: In function 0xac3994ec, the internal func_0352 constructs a transferFrom call using msg.sender as the from address but never validates msg.sender is the owner. Add require(msg.sender == owner) at the entry of 0xac3994ec to prevent unauthorized callers from triggering token transfers from the bot.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is short, but the exploit is a multi-step drain requiring understanding of a protocol-specific router bug, token balances held by the router, and Curve pool interactions to convert stolen assets and manipulate repayment flow. It is not a simple single-call access control issue, but it also lacks the deep cross-transaction/state reasoning of a hard case.
